scope: pilot contract below; full runs use the pinned official STATE backbone through build_official_state_adapter

transfer.backbone: copy only key and shape compatible attention/FFN/LayerNorm tensors
transfer.gene_layers: align by gene symbol, overlapping rows/columns only
transfer.perturbation_projection: align by perturbation name, never integer index
transfer.phase_1: freeze transformer backbone; train new gene and perturbation layers
transfer.phase_2: unfreeze backbone with smaller learning rate

state_validity: NOT_EVALUABLE until a non-destructive same-cell pre-state endpoint exists
